nodes.label: Schizophrenia Care

nodes.label: Clinical Decision Support
nodes.description: High-level mission of the INSIGHT platform: providing clinical decision support, as shown in the logo subtitle.

nodes.label: INSIGHT Logo
nodes.description: Brand logo for the INSIGHT platform. Features a dark blue human head silhouette (side profile) with an open door/gateway motif inside the skull and a purple-blue neural network graph overlaid on the brain region. Wordmark 'INSIGHT' in bold dark navy serif capitals. Tagline: 'CLINICAL DECISION SUPPORT FOR SCHIZOPHRENIA CARE' in spaced uppercase letters.

nodes.label: Neural Network Graph Visual
nodes.description: Visual element in the logo depicting a network of connected nodes (purple-blue gradient) overlaid on the brain area, representing AI/ML inference and Bayesian network reasoning.

nodes.label: Open Door / Gateway Visual
nodes.description: Visual element in the logo depicting an open door or gateway inside the human head silhouette, representing clinical insight, access to information, or decision pathways.
